The '''Gallzar clan''' was a tribe of [[Th'iruckai]]. Its [[Teruk]] or [[King/Legends|king]] was [[Oolan Krim]]. When [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] arrived on their world of [[Th'irus]], the Gallzar clan fought off rivals to host them at their village.
